arguments.question: Across ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, use the seeded daily price series plus SPY and sector benchmarks (XLK; XLC for META) to describe dated 21/63-session trend, drawdown/volatility and relative-performance context. Identify objective review levels or event-sensitive technical risks only where supported; do not forecast returns. Stop after normalized price-series analysis and state data limitations.
arguments.decision_impact: Could distinguish common market/sector momentum from idiosyncratic theses and provide evidence-based review conditions over the stated horizons.
